intro.text: The Malwish Consortium's ambassador to Elendel, who took over the post from Jonnes.

items.text: Daal rose through the military of Scadrial's southern continent to become an admiral and a warship captain. Allik called him "the Primary" and said the Hosts respected him, a sign of success in war.

In 348 PC the Consortium sent him to replace Jonnes, whom it judged too friendly with the Northerners. He brought his old warship to the city to make a point, and his meeting with Wax on board was tense: Daal needled him about the Bands of Mourning and the military strength of North and South, and his crew was colder than other Malwish Wax had known.

He bribed his way onto the Governor's Select Council called over the bomb threat from Bilming, staying silent until the Bands of Mourning came up. He objected, then bargained for their return to the Consortium after one use. When the Bands proved drained, he took them and left, offering the politicians passage out of the city. Steris suspected he had expected this all along.

appearance.text: Short, with an intricate carved mask inlaid with metal around the eyes, which he seems reluctant to lift in the North. At other times he has worn a blood-red mask, or one painted with red lines.

personality.text: Sure of the South's superiority, and quick to show his displeasure toward outsiders he feels have wronged it.
